item.title: XBOX IS A JOKE
item.description:
Well... Microsoft neither confirms nor denies it. Fable will be the last one. It’s over...
Whenever that damn Xbox has PlayStation on the ropes, it always has to screw things up. Now that PlayStation is “going through the worst time of its life LOL,” Xbox had an obligation to put up a fight. Taking the lead would always be impossible because PlayStation has been mainstream ever since it came out, and even normies buy it, even if it’s just to play FIFA. Xbox just needed to keep physical games
